messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing an "admit_score" and clearer dead-letter behavior for model onboarding. want a fast decision so I can write the addendum.

maria: Proposal highlights: admit_score 0-100; pre-admit quick probes (<=10s) compute score; deep bench async. DL mapping: GA, canary, hold, quarantine by score buckets.

tom: +1. Keep score auditable: store per-check scores and weights. No black-box.

sree: Compat checks: tokenizer roundtrip + small embedding stability set. Pre-admit use 8 vectors, deep bench 50. If avg cosine drop > .02 -> compat fail.

alex: Storage: default keep pointers + minimal repro. Persist binaries only if policy says so (persist_binaries=true). Pointers must reference immutable objects (S3 version id).

jen: Telemetry/alerts: classify signals as regression vs transient vs invariant-break. Regression -> persisted bundle + alert. Transient -> retry 3x. Invariant-break -> quarantine and manual signoff.

sam: Make thresholds org-configurable (weights, score thresholds, retry windows). Add admit_policy.ref enum for pre-baked org policies.

maria: Defaults I plan to document: weights perf=40 correctness=40 compat=20; thresholds ga=85 canary=70 hold=50; pointers_ttl=30d hold=60d quarantine=180d.

tom: Need a stable fingerprint: sha256(tokenizer_map + model_config + weights_checksum). Use it to validate pointers.

sree: Add docker-lite repro runner included in minimal bundle to allow "replay locally" without pulling full binaries. Console button can trigger it.

alex: Cost action: I'll estimate quick vs deep bench cost per model and per org.

jen: I'll draft telemetry spec with alerts for score drops >15 and DL transitions. Include run_id linkage.

maria: Action items: I'll draft the RFC addendum (due Thurs). tom+sree: tokenizer-fingerprint + runner proto (PR in 1 week). alex: cost model (by Fri). jen: telemetry spec (next Wed). sam: Console triage UX mock (EOD Tues).

maria: Example minimal repro blob I'll include in addendum (prompt, token_ids, seed, model_fingerprint, pointer). Will also add sample admission descriptor with schema_version to allow future split of acceptance_policy vs runtime_profile.

tom: Keep backwards compatibility; land admit_score as additive field.

maria: Thanks all, pinging for quick reviews after I publish the addendum. :white_check_mark:
